hedging_delta.evidence: Less tariff-uncertainty hedging; more definitive statements like 'well above expectations' and 'strong momentum' replace cautious tariff monitoring language.

tone_delta.evidence: Current call emphasizes 'well above expectations,' 'strong momentum,' 'record computing revenue,' more superlatives than prior's cautious tone.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Automotive shifted from 'weak end market demand' to 'inflection point with 6% year-on-year growth' and 'strong revenue growth' across all end markets.
